blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Eighty-three licensed vendors will be allowed to sell pyrotechnic products at a designated retail zone along the Babag bypass road starting December 16, as Lapu-Lapu City steps up preparations to ensure fire safety and public order ahead of the holiday season. Led by Mayor Cindi King-Chan, city and barangay officials met on Tuesday, October 20, to finalize plans for the designated selling area in Barangay Babag, balancing livelihood opportunities with public safety. The retail strip is set to officially open on December 16, providing vendors with a designated area to sell their products under regulated conditions. READ: […]...
